description: Check an Insights report job returned by ads_query_insights. Use job.id and the same accountId; never re-submit the query to poll. A running result includes progress and pollAfterSeconds. A completed result is one bounded page; use paging.after with this tool for more rows. On 429, respect Retry-After and do not retry in a loop. Reporting 429 responses carry Retry-After. ROW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED means wait until meta.quota.resetsAt (or the error quota reset); do not retry before then.

accountId.description: Ad account ID from the original query.

after.description: Opaque paging.after cursor from this job's previous page.

format.description: table returns row arrays in column order, including actionRows. objects returns keyed rows.

limit.description: Maximum rows; defaults to the original query limit.

waitSeconds.description: Long-poll duration. Follow pollAfterSeconds while the job is running.

name: ads_get_insights_job
title: Get Insights Report Job
